$schema_note: Provenance lock for Oh-My-DSH. This file records concepts and license evidence only; it never stores upstream code or prompt text.

reference.verified_via: GitHub git refs API + root package.json at the tag
reference.note: The dev branch is now 5.x and is not the reference. mass ulw is a 5.x tagline and is out of scope for this alignment.

ported_concepts.port_note: Eleven roles, their boundaries, and their output contracts are re-expressed as DSH agent presets. Prompt text is newly written.
Category and named-agent routing, foreground/background, concurrency queue, cancellation and result files are rebuilt over ctx.subagents.
Plan grammar, drafts, boulder slots, ledger and evidence are re-expressed for .omd.
DSH has no message-transform hook; the detector observes committed user messages and a per-agent prompt section carries the mode protocol. mass ulw is not part of 4.19.4.
DoneClaim and AdversarialVerify shapes are documented in .omd schema docs and enforced by the protocols, not copied text.

ignored_host_bound.reason: OpenCode plugin surface, provider model chains, tmux and MCP integration are host-bound.
Codex CLI plugin surface is not available in DeepSeek Harness.
Team Mode is experimental and off by default in 4.19.4; OMD v0.1.0 uses a wave protocol instead.
tmux panes are replaced by DSH jobs and subagent background tasks.
Provider/model chains are host-owned; OMD accepts DSH provider/model ids from .omd/config.jsonc.

overlap_analysis.method: 8-gram verbatim overlap against sampled upstream prompt and skill documents
overlap_analysis.upstream_sample: public docs/reference/features.md, docs/guide/orchestration.md, and the ulw-plan / start-work skill pages at v4.19.4
overlap_analysis.coverage_gap: The audit samples public pages, not the full upstream tree; the upstream repository is not vendored.

notes: Never run git merge upstream/dev. Synchronization is a reviewed concept-level diff.
Tag and commit are pinned; an unknown tag must fail scripts/check-version.mjs.
No upstream code, prompt text, or asset is stored in this repository.
